captions.detailed: This is a countertop soup blender featuring a wide, matte black plastic base with a circular control dial on the front. Mounted on top is a transparent, wide-mouth glass jar equipped with a black plastic handle and a matching black lid. Inside the jar sits a four-blade steel assembly on a central spindle, and the lid features a small, hinged steam-vent cap at its center for venting hot air.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a countertop soup blender. The assembly should include a wide round base with a front control dial, a transparent wide-mouth glass jar with a side handle, a four-blade assembly at the bottom of the jar on a revolute joint, and a main lid with a small hinged steam-vent cap at its center.
captions.factory: Construct the main base using a revolved profile or lofted cylinder, adding a small cylinder for the front dial. Model the transparent jar as a hollowed shell with an attached swept profile for the handle. Create the four-blade assembly using patterned extrusion profiles on a central cylinder, and define a revolute joint connecting it to the jar bottom. Finally, create the lid as a flat disk with a smaller hinged cylinder representing the steam-vent cap attached via a revolute joint.
